messages:
sam_docs: Spinning up a small thread for a docs PR: adding an "autoscale + KV cache" guidance section to Dedicated provisioning. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1410

ivy_platform: Nice. We need a clear sentence about soft-floor semantics: `min_replicas` is advisory when global GPU pressure exists.

raj_devexp: Agree. Also include a short JS + Python SDK example that shows creating a pool with `min_replicas` and a note about warm-KV hit-rate. Drafts below.

sam_docs: JS draft:
```js
await redwood.dedicated.create({
  name: 'latency-pool',
  gpu_type: 'rtx-a6000',
  autoscale: { min_replicas: 1, max_replicas: 5, burst: 2 }
});
// note: for warm-KV workloads consider min_replicas: 2
```

courtney_prod: Add a one-liner cost callout: "Rough estimate: 1 replica ~ $X/hr (varies by region/SKU); multiply by replicas for ballpark monthly)." Mark it clearly as estimate and link to pricing page.

ivy_platform: Also add a tiny troubleshooting bullet for node affinity errors when requested SKU isn't available in the region (seen in EU-west for some SKUs). Recommend checking `redwoodctl pool describe` before migration.

raj_devexp: Python SLA meta example (tiny):
```py
from redwood import DedicatedClient
c = DedicatedClient()
meta = c.get_pool('latency-pool')
print(meta['availability_priority'])
```

sam_docs: Wording nit from platform: avoid "noisy neighbor proof" phrasing. Use: "tenant isolation reduces noisy neighbor impact but does not imply dedicated physical hardware unless contracted." I'll update copy.

ops-bot: docs-ci: link-check OK for PR #1410 

courtney_prod: Can we include a short migration checklist: dry-run CLI, capacity check, maintenance window, post-migration smoke test? One bullet each.

raj_devexp: I'll add the checklist. Also adding a tiny terraform label mapping snippet so infra folks can automate: 
```hcl
resource "redwood_dedicated_pool" "lat" {
  name = "latency-pool"
  gpu_type = "rtx-a6000"
  labels = { migrated_from = "team-legacy" }
}
```

ivy_platform: Suggest adding a single sentence about autoscale policy interaction with cache TTL: short TTLs + bursty traffic might not warm KV cache quickly; recommend longer warm windows or slightly higher `min_replicas` for critical low-latency paths.

preview-bot: preview built: https://deploy-preview.redwood.dev/docs/dedicated/autoscale-cache-guidance/1410 

sam_docs: Thanks all  I'll fold these in and ping when PR updated. Target merge: next Tue if no blockers.
